en.display_text:
Which of the following pairs is correctly matched with reference to the GCF's Readiness and Preparatory Support Programme (RPSP)?

(a) RPSP readiness grants — uncapped annual support to developing countries, sized based on each country's climate vulnerability index
(b) GCF readiness grants — formally counted toward the USD 100 billion per year climate finance goal as official climate finance disbursements
(c) RPSP delivery — exclusively routed through internationally accredited Multilateral Development Banks to ensure fiduciary standards
(d) RPSP readiness grants — capped at USD 3 million per country per year, used to strengthen National Designated Authorities and develop country programmes for GCF engagement
en.strong_distractor: b — 'GCF readiness grants — count toward the USD 100 billion/year climate finance goal as official climate finance' is tempting because readiness support is GCF-disbursed and government-accounted, and students may not know the specific accounting convention that separates readiness from project finance in climate goal tracking.
elimination_logic: Eliminate option (a): Readiness grants are not unlimited — USD 3 million per country per year is the ceiling; 'uncapped' is factually wrong.

Eliminate option (b): Readiness grants are preparatory/capacity-building support — whether they count toward the USD 100 billion goal is contested, not settled affirmatively; the pair is incorrectly stated.
Eliminate option (c): Readiness support can be channeled through the NDA or directly to national entities — it is not exclusively routed through internationally accredited MDBs.
Select option (d): Readiness grants (up to USD 3 million/country/year) support NDA strengthening and country programme development — the direct and complete function stated here is accurate.
en.upsc_trap_explanation: Option (b) tests a nuanced accounting question: do readiness grants count toward the USD 100 billion/year climate finance goal? This remains contested and the question in option (b) states it 'counts' definitively — which overstates a debated accounting question. Option (a) directly contradicts the USD 3 million ceiling. Option (c) misrepresents the routing requirement. Option (d) accurately describes RPSP's purpose within the ceiling.
en.final_explanation:
GCF's Readiness and Preparatory Support Programme is a capacity-building instrument, not project finance. It operates within a defined ceiling of USD 3 million per country per year and supports countries before they access GCF's project windows.

• Option (a) — Incorrect: Readiness grants are capped at USD 3 million per country per year — they are not uncapped.
• Option (b) — Incorrect: Whether readiness support counts toward the USD 100 billion/year climate finance goal is a contested accounting question — stating it 'counts' definitively misrepresents the situation.
• Option (c) — Incorrect: Readiness support is not required to be routed through internationally accredited MDBs — NDAs and national entities can directly receive it.
• Option (d) — Correct: RPSP provides grants of up to USD 3 million/country/year to strengthen NDAs and develop country programmes — an accurate and complete description.

Value Addition:
• Readiness support ≠ project funding: readiness grants are the preparatory stage enabling future project access.
• The distinction between readiness grants and project disbursements matters for assessing whether climate finance commitments are being met substantively.
• Many LDCs require multiple readiness cycles before achieving accreditation — creating a multi-year capacity-building pathway before any project funding flows.

hi.final_explanation:
GCF का Readiness and Preparatory Support Programme एक क्षमता निर्माण उपकरण है, परियोजना वित्त नहीं। यह प्रति देश प्रति वर्ष USD 3 मिलियन की निर्धारित सीमा के भीतर संचालित होता है और देशों को GCF के परियोजना खिड़कियों तक पहुँचने से पहले सहायता प्रदान करता है।

• विकल्प (a) — गलत: रेडीनेस ग्रांट्स प्रति देश प्रति वर्ष USD 3 मिलियन की सीमा में हैं — वे असीमित नहीं हैं।
• विकल्प (b) — गलत: रेडीनेस सहायता के USD 100 बिलियन प्रति वर्ष जलवायु वित्त लक्ष्य में गिने जाने का प्रश्न विवादित है — इसे निश्चित रूप से 'गिना जाता है' कहना स्थिति को गलत दर्शाता है।
• विकल्प (c) — गलत: रेडीनेस सहायता को अंतरराष्ट्रीय मान्यता प्राप्त MDBs के माध्यम से मार्गित करना आवश्यक नहीं है — NDA और राष्ट्रीय संस्थाएँ सीधे इसे प्राप्त कर सकती हैं।
• विकल्प (d) — सही: RPSP प्रति देश प्रति वर्ष USD 3 मिलियन तक के ग्रांट प्रदान करता है जो NDA को सशक्त बनाता है और GCF सहभागिता के लिए देश कार्यक्रम विकसित करता है — एक सटीक और पूर्ण विवरण।

मूल्य संवर्धन:
• रेडीनेस सहायता ≠ परियोजना वित्त: रेडीनेस ग्रांट्स वह तैयारी चरण हैं जो भविष्य की परियोजना पहुँच को सक्षम बनाते हैं।
• रेडीनेस ग्रांट्स और परियोजना वितरण के बीच अंतर जलवायु वित्त प्रतिबद्धताओं के वास्तविक आकलन के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है।
• कई LDCs को मान्यता प्राप्त करने से पहले कई रेडीनेस चक्रों की आवश्यकता होती है — जो परियोजना वित्त प्रवाह से पहले बहु-वर्षीय क्षमता निर्माण मार्ग बनाता है।
